extends: Capture3d.java / capture-prod3e-raw.json — same rig, same columns, same attestation, same emission rules, all three calibrations carried over unchanged; a NEW case list re-observing the fourteen in-graded-domain shapes task T39 captured through CapturePeriodRatio.java, on a rig that ALSO records the disbursement row's outstanding balance.

attestation.capturePath: Path A — embeddable progressive-loan schedule-generator seam, in-process. No Fineract server is started and no database connection is opened.

classpath.aggregateSha256Definition: sha256 over the newline-joined, lexicographically sorted list of '<sha256>  <classpath entry>' lines

runnerSupplied.NOTE: ECHOED from the runner's environment. NOT measured inside the container — the container cannot read the docker image id or the host checkout. The runner script asserts these independently and fails the run on mismatch.

captures.purpose: RIG CALIBRATION at (12, HALF_UP) — inputs identical to pass 3b P-CAL; must reproduce it digit for digit; NOT a parity vector
RIG CALIBRATION at PRODUCTION (19, HALF_UP) — inputs identical to pass 3b P-00; must reproduce it digit for digit at the precision the parity candidates run at; NOT a parity vector
RIG CALIBRATION at PRODUCTION (19, HALF_UP) in MNT — inputs identical to pass 3c P-EMI-6-1M014632; must reproduce it digit for digit; NOT a parity vector
T39-P0-A re-observed: start 28 Jan, disbursement 31 Jan, MNT 1,200,000 / 6 x 21.6%
T39-P0-B re-observed: start 28 Jan, disbursement 29 Jan (a ONE-DAY seed gap), MNT 1,200,000 / 6 x 21.6%
T39-P0-C re-observed: drift over TWELVE periods, start 29 Jan, MNT 5,000,000 / 12 x 16.8%
T39-P0-D re-observed: 36 periods, MNT 50,000,000 / 21.6% — the largest re-derived gap
T39-P0-E re-observed: drift in a COMMON year (2025), start 28 Jan, MNT 1,200,000 / 6 x 21.6%
T39-P0-F re-observed: drift on the SMALLEST principal, MNT 100 / 6 x 21.6%
T39-P0-G re-observed: drift seeded in MARCH, MNT 2,500,000 / 6 x 16.8%
T39-P0-H re-observed: drift seeded in a 30-DAY month (November), MNT 3,000,000 / 6 x 16.8%
T39-ME-A re-observed: month-end special case on periods 2,4,6, MNT 3,924,149 / 6 x 16.8%
T39-ME-B re-observed: month-end, 31 Jan seed, MNT 1,200,000 / 6 x 21.6%
T39-ME-C re-observed: month-end in a COMMON year (2023), MNT 1,200,000 / 6 x 21.6%
T39-ME-D re-observed: month-end firing on ONE period only, 30 Jan seed, MNT 1,200,000 / 6 x 21.6%
T39-CTL-Q0a re-observed: on-lattice control, MNT 1,200,000 / 6 x 21.6%, start == disbursement == 1 Jan
T39-CTL-2 re-observed: on-lattice control with a MID-MONTH start, MNT 1,200,000 / 6 x 21.6%, start == disbursement == 15 Jan
